title: Furius Spawn
description: A Spawn Plugin made by Furiusfighter213
body:
FuriusSpawn

Description
FuriusSpawn is a lightweight and simple spawn management plugin for Minecraft servers. It allows administrators to set a global spawn and create multiple hubs that players can teleport to. The plugin also includes spawn protection and automatic teleportation when players join the server.

The goal of this plugin is to provide a clean, simple and efficient spawn system without unnecessary complexity.

Supported server software:
Paper, Spigot, Purpur

Supported Minecraft versions:
1.21 – 1.21.11

Features

Set a global server spawn

Automatic teleport to spawn when joining

Spawn protection system

Multiple hub locations

Hub teleport commands

Configurable spawn protection radius

Clean message system with prefix

All plugin messages use the prefix:
[FuriusSpawn]

Commands
/spawn
/setspawn
/sethub <name>
/hub <name>
/hubs

Permissions
furiusspawn.setspawn
furiusspawn.sethub
furiusspawn.admin

Config
The plugin automatically generates the folder:

plugins/FuriusSpawn/

Inside this folder a config.yml file will be created where the spawn location, hub locations and spawn protection radius are stored.
